thread:
Sam: Hey team — moving apartments next weekend and I need to rehome my 34" ultrawide monitor (LG 3440x1440, USB-C + DP). Works perfectly, no dead pixels. Includes stand and DP cable. Pickup from SF office (Brannan floor) — first come, first served. Pics: https://imgur.com/a/xyz123
Leah: Ooh want. Any scratches?
Sam: Barely — one tiny scuff on the bottom bezel, not noticeable when on.
Devon: Is the stand height adjustable?
Sam: Yep, tilt + height. No swivel.
Marco: Can you hold it for me till Monday? I can swing by in the afternoon. @Sam
Sam: @Marco I can hold until Monday if you can pick it up by 5pm. If not then it's fair game.
Olivia: If Marco bails, I'll take it. Been hunting for an ultrawide. :eyes: 
Leah: How much are you asking if someone wants to buy?
Sam: I'm happy to give it away for free if someone picks up. If you'd rather not carry it on Bart: $60 to cover cable + coffee.
Devon: Does it come with the original box?
Sam: No box, sorry. Will wrap in a blanket for transport.
Marco: I can definitely pick it up Monday at 3pm. DM me address? @Sam
Sam: Sent you the exact desk + dropbox.
swap-bot: :white_check_mark: Reminder: If claimed, please react with :package: and the thread will be archived automatically by the swap bot.
Leah: If Marco ghosts, @Leah here — I'll check again on Tuesday morning.
Olivia: Also curious — any chance you have a spare GPU power cable? :)
Sam: No spare cables, only the included DP & USB-C.
Marco: Got it. See you Monday. Thanks @Sam! :thumbsup:
Sam: Sweet — leaving a sticky note on the monitor with the name. Thanks folks!
Leah: Thanks for rehoming instead of tossing, very eco-friendly :seedling:
Devon: :clap:
swap-bot: :package: This item has been marked claimed by Marco. Thread will be archived in 24h.
